name: AI Utilities
description: Small helper service for formatting AI output (markdown to HTML, HTML detection, fence trimming).
project_description:
Provides several small utilities that are useful for AI features provided by other modules, and could also be useful for other types of features.

 Features 
 
 Check if a string is HTML formatted 
 Convert Markdown to HTML 
 Remove a prefix and suffix, and everything before and after to get just the content inbetween 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 
 league/commonmark handles Markdown to HTML conversion and is automatically installed when this module is added with Composer 
 
 Recommended modules/libraries 
 OpenAI Assistants uses this module

 Back to top
